description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans project, specifically testing the integration of IStateMachineStorageProvider implementations, with focus on Azure Storage Blobs and in-memory storage. It defines test classes that instantiate and verify behaviors like persistence, update, removal, enumeration, and recovery of lists backed by different storage providers. It also includes test setup and teardown logic, as well as sample data structures used within the tests.
